# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Unsure about rounding rule for .5; will use half-up to nearest integer.</uncertainty>

import math

spotify_token = globals().get('spotify_token')
playlists = globals().get('all_playlists')
print('playlists_count', len(playlists))

from collections import OrderedDict
playlist_durations_seconds = []

for i,p in enumerate(playlists):
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    title = p.get('title')
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=spotify_token)
    songs = page.get('songs', []) if isinstance(page, dict) else []
    total_sec = sum([s.get('duration',0) for s in songs])
    playlist_durations_seconds.append({
        'playlist_id': pid,
        'title': title,
        'songs_count': len(songs),
        'total_seconds': total_sec
    })
    print('playlist', i, 'title', title, 'songs', len(songs), 'total_seconds', total_sec)

max_item = max(playlist_durations_seconds, key=lambda x: x['total_seconds'])
print('max_item', max_item)

max_minutes = max_item['total_seconds']/60
rounded_minutes = int(math.floor(max_minutes + 0.5))
print('max_minutes', max_minutes, 'rounded_minutes', rounded_minutes)

# also print computed minutes for all
for it in playlist_durations_seconds:
    minutes = it['total_seconds']/60
    print(it['title'], 'minutes', minutes)
